users_facility_by_role.name: users_facility_by_role
users_facility_by_role.value:
("users"."role" IS NULL AND "users"."facility_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("users"."role" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."role" IN ('hospital_admin', 'hospital_staff', 'disposal_operator') AND "users"."facility_id" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("users"."role" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."role" IN ('super_admin', 'driver', 'efda_officer') AND "users"."facility_id" IS NULL)

users_otp_recipient_rules.name: users_otp_recipient_rules
users_otp_recipient_rules.value:
NOT "users"."receives_pickup_otp"
       OR ("users"."role" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."role" IN ('hospital_admin', 'hospital_staff') AND "users"."phone_verified" AND "users"."phone_e164" IS NOT NULL)

containers_exception_reason.name: containers_exception_reason
containers_exception_reason.value: ("containers"."status" IN ('MISSING', 'REFUSED')) = ("containers"."exception_reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("containers"."exception_reason") <> '')

waste_records_cancel_reason.name: waste_records_cancel_reason
waste_records_cancel_reason.value: ("waste_records"."status" = 'CANCELLED') = (("waste_records"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("waste_records"."cancel_reason") <> '') AND "waste_records"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)

trip_stops_collection_fields.name: trip_stops_collection_fields
trip_stops_collection_fields.value:
("trip_stops"."status" IN ('COLLECTED', 'COLLECTED_OVERRIDE')) =
          ("trip_stops"."collection_method" IS NOT NULL AND "trip_stops"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "trip_stops"."confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL)

trip_stops_override.name: trip_stops_override
trip_stops_override.value:
("trip_stops"."status" = 'COLLECTED_OVERRIDE') =
          ("trip_stops"."collection_method" IS NOT NULL AND "trip_stops"."collection_method" = 'OVERRIDE' AND ("trip_stops"."override_reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("trip_stops"."override_reason") <> ''))

trip_stops_arrived_at.name: trip_stops_arrived_at
trip_stops_arrived_at.value: "trip_stops"."status" NOT IN ('ARRIVED', 'COLLECTED', 'COLLECTED_OVERRIDE') OR "trip_stops"."arrived_at" IS NOT NULL

trips_cancel_reason.name: trips_cancel_reason
trips_cancel_reason.value: ("trips"."status" = 'CANCELLED') = (("trips"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("trips"."cancel_reason") <> '') AND "trips"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)

trips_started_at.name: trips_started_at
trips_started_at.value: "trips"."status" NOT IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED') OR "trips"."started_at" IS NOT NULL

certificates_issued_fields.name: certificates_issued_fields
certificates_issued_fields.value:
"certificates"."status" NOT IN ('ISSUED', 'REVOKED')
          OR ("certificates"."file_key" IS NOT NULL AND "certificates"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "certificates"."issued_at" IS NOT NULL)

certificates_revoked_fields.name: certificates_revoked_fields
certificates_revoked_fields.value: ("certificates"."status" = 'REVOKED') = (("certificates"."revoked_reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("certificates"."revoked_reason") <> '') AND "certificates"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

disposal_records_destruction_fields.name: disposal_records_destruction_fields
disposal_records_destruction_fields.value: ("disposal_records"."destroyed_at" IS NOT NULL) = ("disposal_records"."method_id" IS NOT NULL)

invoices_issued_fields.name: invoices_issued_fields
invoices_issued_fields.value:
"invoices"."status" NOT IN ('ISSUED', 'SETTLED_OFFLINE')
          OR ("invoices"."issued_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."due_date" IS NOT NULL)

invoices_settled_fields.name: invoices_settled_fields
invoices_settled_fields.value: ("invoices"."status" = 'SETTLED_OFFLINE') = ("invoices"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("invoices"."settlement_ref" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("invoices"."settlement_ref") <> ''))

invoices_cancel_reason.name: invoices_cancel_reason
invoices_cancel_reason.value: ("invoices"."status" = 'CANCELLED') = ("invoices"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("invoices"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("invoices"."cancel_reason") <> ''))
